title: LISA Foundation
services: Creative Direction, Product Design, UX & Strategy
summary: Collective ownership of blue-chip art — from as little as $1.
cover_alt: The LISA wordmark on a gallery wall
intro: LISA Foundation is the first web3 platform for collective ownership and governance of physical art: investors buy into blue-chip works from as little as $1.

The art market is hard to break into — waitlists last years, the best deals happen behind closed doors and incumbents charge heavy fees. LISA needed a product that made owning art feel open, trustworthy and simple.
outcomes: For over two years we led product and digital design, taking LISA from idea to MVP and beyond: curated discovery, fractional purchase and the ownership experience across web and mobile, underpinned by tokenomics and customer-journey mapping.
In closed beta, two of the first three releases sold out — $105k in sales across 257 collectors. The launch campaign centred on Magdalena Abakanowicz’s Walking Figures with the Vancouver Biennale.

title: Erria
summary: A marketplace connecting buyers directly with independent makers and designers.
cover_alt: The Erria wordmark in maroon on yellow
intro: Erria is a curated marketplace connecting buyers directly with high-end independent makers and designers — with more than 1,500 designers onboard.

As it prepared to scale, Erria needed a sharper brand, a clear story for its revenue model (buyer and seller subscriptions plus a sliding commission) and a better way to discover work — search only filtered by location.
outcomes: We led a 2.0 brand tuning: a refreshed brand system and modular identity that works across social, storefront and packaging.
We designed Erria 2.0 — a new e-commerce marketplace with richer search and map-led discovery — plus a waitlist landing page to articulate the mission, handing the MVP design over in June 2025.

title: Glaze — Calling All Virgins
services: Creative Direction, Campaign, Brand System, Art Direction
summary: Repositioning Super Gloss as the perfect first time for never-coloured hair.
cover_alt: Glaze ‘Calling All Virgins’ billboard above a city rooftop
intro: Glaze challenged us to unlock an overlooked audience hiding in plain sight: the 20 to 30 percent of women under 35 who have never coloured their hair.

The insight was simple but powerful. These “hair virgins” were not avoiding colour forever, they were avoiding the damage, commitment and mess they associated with it. We repositioned Glaze’s Super Gloss as the perfect first time — a no-damage, semi-permanent gloss that works in 10 minutes and delivers high-shine, commitment-free results.
outcomes: BS led the full creative direction for the Virgins campaign, shaping the concept, messaging and visual language from the ground up.
We delivered a bold new brand design system including an exclusive Virgin Blue palette, refined typography, art direction and product photography.
Our team executed a full brand refresh across digital, social media, point of sale and packaging, and developed a 12-week social-first campaign with paid ads and influencer content.
The campaign was shot with photographer Christine Hahn.

title: Decathlon — Design Égalité
services: Service Design, Identity Design, Design Strategy
summary: An innovation framework to move people through the wonders of sport.
cover_alt: The Design Égalité app splash screen on a phone inside a Decathlon campus
intro: Decathlon partnered with SKEWED to define a new internal framework for innovation: Design Égalité, built on “5 moves to move people through the wonders of sport” across five values — Nature, Beauty, Health, Play and Wallet.
The flagship programme plans fifteen projects over five years. The challenge was to make the methodology tangible enough that product and retail teams would actually use it.
outcomes: Working with SKEWED, we shaped the experience narrative, visual storytelling and presentation framework used to communicate Design Égalité across the business.

Through autumn 2025 we applied the 5 Moves to a real product — the Quechua camping chair — ran ideation sessions, wrote the communications strategy and specified a toolbox, including its interface, to guide teams through ideation, validation and rollout.

title: Figma Slides × BS — The Infinite Scroll
summary: A community template for the launch of Figma Slides.
cover_alt: The Infinite Scroll title slide — embossed parchment between chrome scroll handles
intro: For the launch of Figma Slides, BS were asked to collaborate and launch a new template for the community, showcasing the power of the tool and its potential applications.
outcomes: We created The Infinite Scroll — an ancient-manuscript inspired template with embossed parchment, chrome scroll handles and built-in text effects.
Slides push seamlessly into one another, so a deck becomes a single continuous story: add as many slides as you need, end with your logo or a short message — or keep going, forever.

title: Meadow
services: Brand Identity, Symbol System, Art Direction, Packaging, Social
summary: A living system — a calm, design-led wellness brand built around Micro and Macro.
cover_alt: “A living system” — a fisheye flower field with the Meadow symbol at its centre
intro: Meadow is a Lisbon-based brand bringing calm, science-informed microdosing to people across Europe, built around two kits: Micro, for focus and clarity, and Macro, for perspective and reflection.

The brief was to stand apart from a category that feels either spiritual or synthetic — to be a gentle guide, not a guru — for design-minded professionals aged 25–40, with the ambition of becoming Europe’s most trusted name in the space.
outcomes: We built the identity around a living system: calm, open and simple above ground, with a vast network of connection and growth below — expressed through the wordmark, symbol and a fisheye photographic world.

The system runs through the pill packs and compact, sleeves and embossed boxes, kraft mailers, field notes, the app and social, giving Meadow a quiet confidence from first glance to the product in hand.

title: amika: connect
services: Event Identity, Stage & LED Environment, Presentation System, Merch, Brand Playbook
summary: Game Time at the House of amika — the identity and world for amika’s annual conference.
cover_alt: The amika:connect lockup on the main-stage LED wall with the GAMEDAY ticker
intro: amika:connect is amika’s first amika-only company conference — a moment to come together, reflect, share ideas, celebrate progress and align around what comes next.
For February 2026 in San Antonio, the theme was “Game Time at the House of amika” — a Super Bowl-inspired signal that amika now plays at the top level.
outcomes: We built the whole conference world: a flexible amika:connect lockup, gradient key visuals, dot-matrix GAMEDAY typography, stage and LED environments, idle-screen states and lobby LED loops.

The system carried through two mainstage presentation decks, name badges and merch — jerseys numbered with each employee’s start year, Accolades varsity jackets and custom patches — all documented in a brand playbook.

title: Emma Reicher
services: Brand Identity, 3D World, Website, Brochures, Social
summary: Outgrow your relationship to your mind — the brand world and website for Emma Reicher.
cover_alt: The Emma Reicher hero lockup over an overgrown garden path
intro: Emma Reicher is a psychotherapist, group analyst and founder of Field Therapy, weaving the integrity of psychotherapy with the intelligence of maturation and the vitality of elemental Chi Kung.
Her work speaks to people who sense there is more to reality than thought — therapists, creatives, leaders and healers. She needed a brand that could hold that depth without feeling esoteric.
outcomes: We created a brand world around The Totem — a family of sculptural, shape-shifting forms rendered in many materials — with an elemental colour system of Wood, Water, Earth, Energy, Fire and Psychic.

It comes to life on emmareicher.com: frosted-glass panels over open landscapes, programme “portals” such as Dreams Decoded and Vision Quest, plus brochures, Instagram templates for the Chi Kung Collective and a case film.
